items.source:
The class is intended for concise, type-aware criteria construction through a type-safe DSL where property references
are preferred over string-based navigation.
items.translation: 该类旨在通过类型安全的 DSL 构建简洁且具备类型感知的条件，其中优先使用属性引用而非基于字符串的导航。

items.source: The resulting expression can be used in predicates. Expression resolution navigates joins as necessary.
items.translation: 生成的表达式可用于谓词中。表达式解析会根据需要导航连接操作。

items.source: The resulting object can be used in the selection, joined paths consider outer joins as needed.
items.translation: 生成的对象可用于选择，合并路径时根据需要采用外部连接。

items.source: Utility methods to resolve JPA Criteria API objects using Spring Data's type-safe property references. These helper methods obtain Criteria API objects using TypedPropertyPath and PropertyReference to resolve property expressions and joins.
items.translation: 提供用于通过 Spring Data 的类型安全属性引用解析 JPA Criteria API 对象的实用方法。这些辅助方法利用 TypedPropertyPath 和 PropertyReference 来解析属性表达式和连接。

items.source:
Root<User> root = criteriaQuery.from(User.class);

Expression<User> expr = Expressions.get(root, User::getManager);

Join<User, Address> join = Expressions.join(root, JoinType.INNER, j -> j.join(User::getAddress));
items.translation:
Root<User> root = criteriaQuery.from(User.class);

Expression<User> expr = Expressions.get(root, User::getManager);

Join<User, Address> join = Expressions.join(root, JoinType.INNER, j -> j.join(User::getAddress));
